articles.summary: Kalshi has partnered with Signify Group to monitor and act on online abuse targeting athletes and coaches across the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL and ATP Tour.
articles.title: Kalshi Partners With Signify Group to Protect Athletes From Online Abuse and Threats

articles.summary: Four tribal nations are launching independent prediction market apps — PokkeTrades, Greenville, Sovereign Edge, and AIR Markets — each built on Kalshi's federally regulated exchange.
articles.title: Four More Tribes Enter the Prediction Market Business with Apps Powered by Kalshi

articles.summary: Kalshi launched Brier scores, low-volume tags, and real-time activity feeds for its 2026 midterm election markets as election trading volume surpasses 2024 levels.
articles.title: Amidst Record Growth in Election Markets, Kalshi Launches New Transparency Features for Midterm Elections
